newsitem.title: USA: PPG Industries upgrades glass plant.
newsitem.headline: PPG Industries upgrades glass plant.

text.p: PPG Industries said on Monday it began a $15 million upgrade of its specialty glass plant in Georgia, in order to enhance operations and production yields there.
Glass production at the plant would be suspended for about two months while new ceramic refractory materials were installed in the melting tank, the company said.
The company said it did not anticipate any layoffs during the process. The work included installing new inspection and packing equipment.
Enhancements to the annealing lehr to increase process consistency and product yields will enable PPG to expand availability of its specialty glasses, it said.
An annealing lehr is a type of oven which is part of the glassmaking process.
